content.title: WHAT BIG PHARMA DOESN'T WANT YOU TO KNOW ABOUT YOUR {{ORGANS}}
facts: **Pancreas** - Bitter melon, Okra, Cinnamon - these help steady the insulin response instead of spiking it.
**Liver** - Beets, Walnuts, Grapefruit - these support the enzymes that flush out toxins overnight.
**Bladder** - Cranberries, Cucumber, Watermelon - these keep the lining flushed and less prone to irritation.
**Thyroid** - Brazil nuts, Seaweed, Pumpkin seeds - these feed the gland the raw materials it needs to make hormones.
**Bone marrow** - Beef liver, Lentils, Dark cherries - these fuel the cells that make your red blood cells.
**Ears (inner)** - Bananas, Dark leafy greens, Salmon - these support the fluid balance behind hearing and balance.
**Follow along** - for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Your pancreas quietly runs the show on blood sugar, and bitter melon has natural compounds that mimic insulin's effect on your cells, helping glucose actually get used instead of just floating in your bloodstream. Your liver processes almost everything you eat or drink, and beets contain betaine, which helps liver cells process fat more efficiently so they don't get sluggish. Your thyroid needs selenium and iodine to convert its hormones into the active form your body actually uses, which is exactly why brazil nuts and seaweed matter more than people realize. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and adjust from there.
